content.title: Dual-Material Symmetric Duel | Identity Setup, Range Exchange, Embodied Collision
content.summary: A glassblower and cryogenic engineer escalate heat and vapor into one test-floor collision. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Two adult roles have distinct material identities and fixed sides. + Close contact proves both materials before ranged escalation. + Attack directions remain readable across the center line. + Each material grows into a distinct coherent form. + The final collision preserves both origins and one shared impact point.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one adult glassblower with amber heat and one adult cryogenic engineer with cyan vapor on opposite sides of a circular test floor. Separate them and exchange one amber ribbon and one cyan pressure wave across the same center line. Collide both original material forms at the center marker and hold the two adults outside the residue ring.
required_anchors: Two adult roles have distinct material identities and fixed sides.
Close contact proves both materials before ranged escalation.
Each material grows into a distinct coherent form.
The final collision preserves both origins and one shared impact point.
